constraints.description: Exactly fifteen dependency-ordered guides and four compatibility pages exist with classified source records, current authorities, frontmatter, required concepts, and resolvable local links.

validation.validation_method: Developer-reference manifest validation plus missing-guide and unclassified-authority negative controls

constraints.description: API summaries, compatibility adapters, event families, MCP and A2A discovery, authorization, execution, and state boundaries remain distinct and source-backed.

validation.validation_method: Current-source review plus invented-endpoint, exhaustive-OpenAPI, protocol-parity, discovery-as-authorization, and production-proxy controls

constraints.description: Checked-in SDK source, locally generated references, hosted Pages references, and registry publication are reported as independent facts.

validation.validation_method: Source and staging review plus hosted-Python-reference and registry-from-metadata controls

constraints.description: Configuration and deployment guidance uses placeholders, binds anonymous mode to loopback, separates health from build success, includes rollback, and does not transfer profile evidence.

validation.validation_method: Configuration and deployment source review plus anonymous-listener, profile-transfer, health, rollback, and workflow-policy controls

constraints.description: Public content excludes private excerpts, credentials, keys, machine paths, and raw payloads, while source verification makes no build, browser, deployment, runtime, registry, or cross-profile claim.

validation.validation_method: Private-excerpt, TypeScript, publication, architecture, brand, product, security, developer-reference, staging, and Actions-policy controls

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and developer-reference manifest as the publication authority.
Run routine verification locally; GitHub Actions remain deployment-only.
Do not run the phase-level build or browser certification before all documentation content is complete.
Do not infer runtime, protocol, registry, deployment, rollback, or cross-profile readiness from documentation-source evidence.
termination_conditions: All five blocking content constraints have observed evidence.
Every isolated negative control fails for its intended defect before the complete fixture passes.
Strict OpenSpec and all refiner schemas pass.
The review explicitly states its build, browser, deployment, runtime, registry, rollback, and cross-profile evidence limits.
